query:
SELECT fo.id, fo.chip_storage_key
            FROM face_occurrences fo
            WHERE fo.asset_id = $1
              AND fo.owner_id = $2
              AND fo.detection_model_pack_id = $3
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM face_embeddings fe
                  WHERE fe.face_occurrence_id = fo.id
                    AND fe.owner_id = fo.owner_id
                    AND fe.model_pack_id = $4
              )
            FOR UPDATE
